Cookie Queens is a 2026 American documentary film directed and produced by Alysa Nahmias. It explores the joys, pains, and pressures of the Girl Scout Cookies season. Prince Harry, Duke of Sussex and Meghan, Duchess of Sussex serve as executive producers under their Archewell Productions banner. It had its world premiere at the 2026 Sundance Film Festival on January 25, 2026.
Premise
Cookie Queens follows four young women striving to become their own "Cookie Queen", and be a top seller of Girl Scout Cookies.
Production
The film received support from the Sundance Documentary Fund. Prince Harry, Duke of Sussex and Meghan, Duchess of Sussex serve as executive producers under their Archewell Productions banner. The film was also produced in association with Good Gravy Films and Artemis Rising Foundation.
Release
It had its world premiere at the 2026 Sundance Film Festival on January 25, 2026. In March 2026, Roadside Attractions acquired U.S. distribution rights to the film.
